entries.reason: mmap region access via raw pointer arithmetic
entries.invariant: slot_index < slot_count maintained by Mutex<Vec<usize>>; offset + slot_size <= total_size
safety_assumptions: Mutex<Vec<usize>> serialises all alloc/free — no concurrent slot_index aliasing
mmap region valid for lifetime of HugePagePool
HugePagePool outlives all PoolBuffer instances (enforced by drop assert)
entries.notes: ABA race (SUSPECT #1) eliminated: Treiber CAS stack replaced with Mutex<Vec>. Drop asserts zero active buffers before munmap.

entries.reason: raw pointer access to mmap slot
entries.invariant: ptr valid for capacity bytes; as_slice/as_mut_slice only expose [0, len); uninit_buf_mut returns MaybeUninit
safety_assumptions: len <= capacity always (enforced by set_len assert)
write() sets len = bytes_written before any read via as_slice()
entries.notes: SUSPECT #4 fixed: as_mut_slice previously returned capacity bytes including uninit. Now returns only [0, len). uninit_buf_mut added for kernel I/O path.

entries.reason: raw slice from mmap'd UMEM region (AF_XDP kernel-shared memory)
entries.invariant: addr + len <= umem.size (checked via assert before pointer arithmetic)
safety_assumptions: addr comes from RX ring descriptor (kernel-produced)
frame_slice called only after descriptor dequeued from RX ring
entries.notes: SUSPECT #2 (OOB) fixed: checked_add + assert in frame_slice/_mut. Sync soundness (kernel RX-DMA vs userspace read) is now a documented, reviewed invariant on `unsafe impl Sync for Umem` (frame ownership is RX-ring-mediated: read only post-dequeue, pre-refill, no aliasing). Umem is owned by value in a single socket and not shared as &Umem across threads, so Sync may alternatively be removed.
entries.remaining_concern: NEEDS-REVIEW: Sync impl allows shared refs across threads; AF_XDP ordering is semantic, not structural

entries.reason: self-referential struct: msghdr.msg_iov points into same struct
entries.invariant: MsgHdrStorage address stable after setup; stored in Box<[MsgHdrStorage]> which never reallocates
safety_assumptions: Box<[T]> has fixed heap address — no reallocation unlike Vec<T>
MsgHdrStorage not moved after setup_recv/setup_send called
io_uring SQE lifetime bounded by completion — msghdr not freed before CQE
entries.notes: SUSPECT #3 fixed: Vec<MsgHdrStorage> replaced with Box<[MsgHdrStorage]>. Self-referential pointers stable for lifetime of UringEngine.

entries.reason: expose uninitialised BytesMut bytes for recv_from syscall
entries.invariant: recv_from overwrites first n bytes; truncate(n) before any read; no uninit bytes observed
safety_assumptions: recv_from writes exactly n bytes it reports
truncate called immediately after recv_from with returned n
entries.notes: Standard pattern for zero-copy UDP recv. SAFETY comment present in code.

entries.reason: write_volatile to every 4096th byte of mmap region
entries.invariant: ptr valid for total_size bytes; step 4096 covers all pages without OOB
safety_assumptions: total_size is aligned to 2MiB (computed in new())
write_volatile does not optimise away — required for prefault semantics

entries.invariant: ptr != MAP_FAILED checked; NonNull::new enforces non-null
safety_assumptions: PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE on anonymous mapping is always valid
size computed as frame_count * frame_size without overflow (u32 * u32 fits usize on 64-bit)
entries.notes: frame_count * frame_size overflow now rejected in Umem::new via checked_mul + non-zero guard, before mmap. Prevents a wrapped (too-small) size from defeating the frame_slice bounds check (USF-002).

entries.invariant: munmap called exactly once in Drop; no double-free; size matches original mmap
safety_assumptions: total_size stored at construction, passed unchanged to munmap
